recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Re-applying FHIR-13347 literally would reverse later work-group decisions and reintroduce an out-of-build Media dependency; future multimedia-observation changes should be evaluated against the current Observation/DocumentReference/DiagnosticReport model.
issue_request: FHIR-13347 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 OO change request asking that Media be allowed as an alternative to Observation for photo, video, and audio observations. Its accepted resolution removed Observation.value[x] Attachment in that era, added direct Media relationship targets for Observation-derived content, and called for ongoing Media/Observation alignment.
initial_application: The change was applied historically by GF#13347 source commits: ded8a0f added ballot/boundary guidance explaining removal of valueAttachment and use of Media, and 37fadcd removed Attachment from Observation.value[x]. The current source no longer carries the issue key directly.
additional_context: Later final decisions changed the intended model. FHIR-13421 moved Media boundary ownership to OO; FHIR-15145 and FHIR-18304 declined further Media-as-Observation linkage requests; FHIR-19250 merged Media's practical role into DocumentReference and removed Media from the active resource list; and FHIR-24693 restored Observation.valueAttachment for R5/R6 with guidance about valueAttachment, derivedFrom, and DiagnosticReport.presentedForm.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini lists Observation and DocumentReference as active resources but not Media; Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] include Attachment; Observation.derivedFrom includes DocumentReference, ImagingStudy, ImagingSelection, QuestionnaireResponse, and Observation but not Media; and DiagnosticReport.media.link references DocumentReference.

related_jiras.note: Transferred Media boundary ownership to OO and framed the need to differentiate Media and Observation.
Retracted/no-change request to add Media to Observation.hasMember after DiagnosticReport was accepted as the better model for images in result sets.
No-change decision for non-ImagingStudy media support, noting Media boundaries and derivedFrom DocumentReference.
Merged Media's role into DocumentReference and removed Media from the active core resource list.
Restored Observation.valueAttachment for R5/R6 and required guidance distinguishing valueAttachment, derivedFrom, and DiagnosticReport.presentedForm.
